verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a multilingual model (flux-general-multi) covering 10 languages with 'in-conversation language switching'. That implies the model recognizes the spoken language without being told, but the pack never explicitly documents an automatic language-detection feature or a detected-language output. Missing for 10: an explicit language-detection capability or parameter, a returned detected-language field, coverage beyond 10 languages, detection for pre-recorded audio, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the service can detect the spoken language automatically instead of requiring me to declare it

citations.quote: Multilingual (flux-general-multi, 10 languages with in-conversation language switching)
